Sure thing! 🌟 Below is a quick safety‑first outline for adding a “Download my data” button in your Lovable app that uses Supabase. I’ll hit the key safety points first, then ask a couple of quick questions to make sure the feature only pulls what you actually want to let users download. --- ### Safety parts we’ll build in | Feature | Safety part | |---------|-------------| | **Photo or file uploads** | Not relevant here unless you’re also letting them download files they uploaded. | | **Logins with email only** | We’ll use Supabase Auth’s magic‑link login (already in place). | | **Personal data** | *Red level* protection – each user can only see their own rows. | | **“Download my data”** | • Send the data **only** from the server (no secrets in the browser).
• Include a **confirmation step** (you’re sure you want to download).
• Bundle the data in a **JSON or CSV** file (no private keys, no PII of other users).
• Rate‑limit to avoid abuse (once per X minutes).
• Re‑check any RLS/grant policies on the tables you pull. | | **Supabase** | Enable Row‑Level Security (RLS) on all tables you’ll expose, and test with the “stranger test” (two test accounts) later. | --- ### Quick starter questions 1. **What data do they need?** *All tables the user can see? Only certain tables? CSV vs JSON?* 2. **Do you also want to let them download any files they uploaded (photos, attachments)?** *If yes, we’ll zip them with the data.* Once you let me know, I’ll give you a one‑screen plan (Risk level, steps, safety recap) and a small code snippet for the button + server function. If you’re happy, we can jump straight to the code!
